en.description:
Reality isn't broken - it just follows different rules!

A mysterious cosmic event interrupts a scientist's experiment, tearing open a bridge to an unknown Quantum World. To survive in this impossible realm, his physical body is transformed into a tiny, transparent quantum orb - the only form stable enough to exist there.

Imagine the familiar idea of a higher-dimensional being entering our 3-dimensional world. Now reverse it. A human consciousness has fallen into a reality it was never meant to perceive. Space twists, paths overlap and directions lose their meaning. What looks like a simple maze is actually a world your brain cannot fully understand.

Guide the scientist, now trapped inside his fragile quantum form, through surreal labyrinths, avoid dangerous anomalies, and solve puzzles that challenge your perception. Every level brings him one step closer to escaping the Quantum World and returning home.

Features
• Control a transparent quantum orb through mysterious mazes.
• Explore worlds with impossible geometry and shifting perspectives.
• Solve clever puzzles inspired by quantum concepts.
• Atmospheric minimalist visuals and immersive sound.
• Easy controls with increasingly challenging gameplay.
• Help the scientist find the path back to reality.

Can you escape a world that obeys laws beyond human understanding?
en.subtitle: Escape the Quantum Maze
